post_install_scripts:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Enabling core desktop and hardware services'
systemctl enable sddm || true
systemctl enable NetworkManager || true
systemctl enable bluetooth || true
systemctl enable power-profiles-daemon || true
systemctl enable fstrim.timer || true
systemctl enable fwupd-refresh.timer || true
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Enabling AppArmor and automatic security updates'
systemctl enable apparmor || true
cat > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades << 'EOF'
APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";
APT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "1";
APT::Periodic::AutocleanInterval "7";
EOF
systemctl enable unattended-upgrades || true
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Installing default-deny nftables firewall ruleset'
cat > /etc/nftables.conf << 'EOF'
#!/usr/sbin/nft -f
flush ruleset

table inet filter {
    chain input {
        type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop;
        iif "lo" accept
        ct state established,related accept
        ct state invalid drop
        udp sport 67 udp dport 68 accept
        udp sport 547 udp dport 546 accept
        ip protocol icmp accept
        ip6 nexthdr icmpv6 accept
    }
    chain forward {
        type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop;
    }
    chain output {
        type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept;
    }
}
EOF
systemctl enable nftables || true
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Applying kernel/network hardening sysctls'
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-persisos-hardening.conf << 'EOF'
kernel.kptr_restrict=2
kernel.dmesg_restrict=1
kernel.yama.ptrace_scope=1
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=1
net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=1
net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts=1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0
net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects=0
net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects=0
fs.protected_hardlinks=1
fs.protected_symlinks=1
EOF
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Installing Plasma Theme and Wallpapers'
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/share/plasma/. /usr/share/plasma/
mkdir -p /usr/share/wallpapers
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/share/wallpapers/. /usr/share/wallpapers/
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Installing Background Script'
install -m 0755 /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/bin/persisos-apply-theme /usr/bin/persisos-apply-theme
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Installing PersisOS Calamares configuration'
install -Dm 0644 /.temp_assets/calamares/settings.conf /etc/calamares/settings.conf
install -Dm 0644 /.temp_assets/calamares/modules/unpackfs.conf /etc/calamares/modules/unpackfs.conf
install -Dm 0644 /.temp_assets/calamares/modules/packagechooser.conf /etc/calamares/modules/packagechooser.conf
cp -a /.temp_assets/calamares/branding /usr/share/calamares/
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Applying desktop, xdg and SDDM config'
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/etc/xdg/. /etc/xdg/
mkdir -p /etc/sddm.conf.d /etc/skel/Desktop
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/etc/sddm.conf.d/. /etc/sddm.conf.d/
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/etc/skel/Desktop/. /etc/skel/Desktop/
chmod 0755 /etc/skel/Desktop/*.desktop
live_home=$(getent passwd user | cut -d: -f6)
if [ -n "$live_home" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 -o user -g user "$live_home/Desktop"
    cp -a /etc/skel/Desktop/. "$live_home/Desktop/"
    install -m 0755 -o user -g user /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/share/applications/install-persisos.desktop "$live_home/Desktop/Install PersisOS.desktop"
    chown -R user:user "$live_home/Desktop"
fi
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/share/icons /usr/share/
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/share/sddm /usr/share/
cp -a /.temp_assets/persisos-plasma-theme/usr/share/applications /usr/share/
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
# Override Debian display identity while keeping its upstream release metadata.
cp /usr/lib/os-release /tmp/persisos-os-release
sed -i '/^\(NAME\|PRETTY_NAME\|ID\|ID_LIKE\|VERSION\|VERSION_ID\|VARIANT\|VARIANT_ID\|LOGO\|HOME_URL\|SUPPORT_URL\|BUG_REPORT_URL\)=/d' /tmp/persisos-os-release
cat >> /tmp/persisos-os-release <<'EOF'
NAME="PersisOS"
PRETTY_NAME="PersisOS 2.0"
ID=persisos
ID_LIKE=debian
VERSION="2.0"
VERSION_ID="2.0"
VARIANT="Desktop"
VARIANT_ID=desktop
LOGO=persisos
HOME_URL="https://github.com/arshavirm/PersisOS"
SUPPORT_URL="https://github.com/arshavirm/PersisOS/issues"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://github.com/arshavirm/PersisOS/issues"
EOF
install -m 0644 /tmp/persisos-os-release /usr/lib/os-release
ln -sfn ../usr/lib/os-release /etc/os-release
rm /tmp/persisos-os-release
printf '%s\n' 'PersisOS 2.0 \n \l' > /etc/issue
printf 'PersisOS 2.0\n' > /etc/issue.net
mkdir -p /etc/default/grub.d
printf 'GRUB_DISTRIBUTOR="PersisOS 2.0"\n' > /etc/default/grub.d/50-persisos.cfg
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo 'Removing Temp directory'
rm -rf /.temp_assets
